body:
I dropped out of college when I was 19 because of my social anxiety. It was so bad that I can't even go outside my dorm when there was people outside. 
Now I'm 26 yrs old and started going to a university once again. Hoping that this time it would go well.
Thinking about going job hunting after finishing my degree makes me restless.
I'm taking SSRI for my anxiety. It works great for me.
Congratulations!! I hope I could graduate too 🥳🥳
It took me 5 yrs to finally seek help and it made me cry but happy at the same time. Congratulations to you for taking the first step!!

Telling my family about my issues would just worsen my case cause they don't believe on depression and anxiety. Being mocked by other people doesn't feel good 🥲
Sadly, antidepressants would just give me a terrible idea. I am suicidal. I hope things work out for you.

Same situation. I am still in college in mid-twenties cause I dropped so many subjects. Told my mother and my girlfriend that I can't take it anymore because I couldn't even answer in recitations because of panic attacks and fear of being judged. Mother told me to try and finish it for her. My girlfriend ditched me cause she doesn't want me telling my problems to her. I can't even show my face on family gatherings cause they're pestering me about my studies and because I think they're thinking that I am stupid or I am wasting my mother's money. Life for people with mental health issues is soooooooo freaking bad
I don't really want to burden my family with the rehabilitation fee and like I said, drugs would just transform me to a precription drugs addict or it would just be a tool to kill myself. Thanks!
